currency: copies of rho both arms (Q = 2 x Bell samples)
criterion: one Wald SPRT per rung, A(n)=log((4^n-1)/0.01)
claim: SEPARATION IN SCALING: C1 ~ 3^n emission-covering, Q ~ linear in n
seal_free_validation: C1 and Q are independent estimators; agreement is checkable without the seal (chance agreement = 1/(4^n-1))
caveats: n=4/n=6 predate the in-flight readout cal; headline curve uses a COMMON q so the SHAPE is not confounded by epoch drift
each rung is ONE draw of P; the C1 meter depends on where P falls in the committed candidate walk order (n=8 P sits 22.6% in => cheaper C1 => SMALLER margin, i.e. the conservative direction)
n=8 seal NOT revealed at time of writing; both P_hat are blind estimates

walk_position_decomposition.finding: The measured C1 cost is driven by WHERE the sealed P sorts in the committed lexicographic candidate order, not by the 3^n emission: C1/walk_position is near-constant (2.45/2.18/1.74 copies per candidate walked) while C1/3^n varies 2.1x.
walk_position_decomposition.why_it_matters: The classical arm as pre-registered walks candidates in a fixed committed order, so its cost genuinely depends on where the truth sits. Expected cost over a uniformly random sealed P is the walk-median value.
walk_position_decomposition.direction_of_bias: ALL THREE draws landed BELOW the 50% median walk position (44.7% / 15.4% / 22.6%), so every as-executed C1 is CHEAPER than expected and every as-executed margin UNDERSTATES the expected-over-P margin. Conservative.
walk_position_decomposition.independent_corroboration: Median-normalizing reproduces the PRE-REGISTERED frozen_C1_benchmark (exp142c_decode_elder_c6567_PREREVEAL.json) to 1.00x at n=6 and 1.02x at n=8 - the flown data recovers a benchmark fixed before it.
